tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Coral. Primary CTA fill, coral callout cards, wordmark accent. Scarce on single elements. White text on it is 3.3:1 — passes only for large text (24px+, or 18.7px bold); see primary-active for small labels.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed coral. Also the safe coral for small text and links on canvas (6.6:1) and under white button labels (7:1).

tokens.name: primary-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled CTA fill, with muted text.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page floor. Tinted cream — never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Section dividers, very soft bands, sidebars.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Feature and content cards, active category tab. One step darker than canvas.

tokens.name: surface-cream-strong
tokens.usage: Selected tabs, emphasised bands.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Code windows, product mockups, featured pricing tier, footer. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-dark-elevated
tokens.usage: Elevated panels and secondary buttons inside dark cards.

tokens.name: surface-dark-soft
tokens.usage: Inner code block inside a larger dark card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on canvas (18.6:1).

tokens.name: body-strong
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs, emphasised body.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Default running text (10.6:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Sub-headings, breadcrumbs, secondary labels (5.2:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: muted-soft
tokens.usage: Captions and fine print. 3.4:1 on canvas — large text or non-essential text only (source value, flagged).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders on cream surfaces. Reads as one elevation step, not a line; under 3:1, so pair inputs with a focus ring (source value, flagged).

tokens.name: hairline-soft
tokens.usage: Barely visible divider inside one band.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on coral fills (see the contrast note on primary).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Cream-tinted white on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: on-dark-soft
tokens.usage: Footer body and secondary labels on dark surfaces (6.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Sparingly: terminal status, active-connection dots. Not for text on canvas (2.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: Category badges and small inline highlights. Not for text on canvas.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Green status dots, available indicators.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning callouts (rare).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Validation errors (4.6:1 on canvas).

families.display: Copernicus, "Tiempos Headline", "Cormorant Garamond", "EB Garamond", Georgia, serif
families.sans: StyreneB, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Pricing tier names, callout headlines, prices.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Footer body, fine print, dense UI.

styles.name: caption-uppercase
styles.usage: Category tags, NEW badges. Set uppercase.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Base unit; icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Code-window and connector-tile padding; cookie card.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Feature, pricing and model card padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Coral callout padding.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between major bands; hero vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badge accents, tiny dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inline buttons, dropdown items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, category tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content and product cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero illustration container, marquee components.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, NEW tags, avatars, icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Rare. Depth comes from cream-vs-dark surfaces, not shadows.
